notes.zh-CN:
修复实况照片播放模糊：按画布实际尺寸解码，播放清晰度恢复到视频原始分辨率
图片打开失败时，提示原因改为跟随界面语言显示，并区分文件损坏与格式不支持
notes.en-US:
Fixed blurry Live Photo playback: videos are now decoded at the visible canvas size, restoring the full original resolution
Image open failure messages now follow the UI language and distinguish corrupt files from unsupported formats

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 修复实况照片播放模糊：按画布实际尺寸解码，播放清晰度恢复到视频原始分辨率
图片打开失败时，提示原因改为跟随界面语言显示，并区分文件损坏与格式不支持

en-US.title: Changes
items: Fixed blurry Live Photo playback: videos are now decoded at the visible canvas size, restoring the full original resolution
Image open failure messages now follow the UI language and distinguish corrupt files from unsupported formats

en-US.title: Changes
items: Much smoother video and Live Photo playback: hardware-accelerated decoding and decoding at display size cut stutter and CPU usage on high-resolution videos, and the first frame appears faster.
When you reach the first or last image, a hint appears at the top; press the same direction again to wrap around to the other end.
Fixed hint text being hard to read in the light theme.

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 大幅改善视频与实况照片的播放流畅度：启用显卡硬件解码并按显示尺寸解码，高分辨率视频播放更顺滑、CPU 占用更低，打开视频的首帧也更快。
翻图到第一张或最后一张时，顶部会给出提示；再按一次同一方向，才会绕回另一端。
修复浅色主题下顶部提示文字看不清的问题。

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 「打开图片 / 视频」与「打开文件夹」合并为一个入口：打开对话框中选中文件打开文件、选中文件夹打开文件夹，也可输入文件夹路径或点「打开此文件夹」。
「更多」菜单新增「打开所在文件夹」，可在访达中定位当前图片；图片右键菜单的同名入口保留。
首启文件关联引导支持图片、视频分组选择，避免与其他弹窗叠加；安装路径变化后自动刷新候选应用注册。
修复多窗口重复检查更新的问题，已经下载好的更新保持待安装状态。
修复菜单和弹窗按键被主窗口抢占，以及关闭下拉框时可能发生的崩溃；补齐反馈菜单图标。
统一深浅主题下的弹窗和关联设置布局，改善多窗口语言切换与文字保存提示。
完善可关闭的关联操作统计，修复会话识别和拒收事件阻塞后续上报的问题。

en-US.title: Changes
items: Merged 'Open image / video' and 'Open folder' into a single entry: in the open dialog, selecting a file opens it and selecting a folder opens the folder; you can also type a folder path or click 'Open this folder'.
Added 'Open containing folder' to the More menu to reveal the current image in Finder; the image context menu keeps the same entry.
Choose image and video associations in separate groups during onboarding, avoid overlapping dialogs, and refresh candidate registration when the installation path changes.
Avoid repeated update checks when opening multiple windows and retain updates that are ready to install.
Keep menu and dialog keys separate from viewer shortcuts, fix a possible crash when closing a dropdown, and add the missing Feedback menu icon.
Unify dialogs and association settings across light and dark themes, and improve language changes across windows and text save prompts.
Improve optional association statistics, session identification, and delivery of events after a rejected event.

en-US.title: Windows x64 changes
items: Merged 'Open image / video' and 'Open folder' into a single entry: in the open dialog, selecting a file opens it and selecting a folder opens the folder; you can also type a folder path or click 'Open this folder'.
Added 'Open containing folder' to the More menu to reveal the current image in Explorer; the image context menu keeps the same entry.

zh-CN.title: Windows x64 更新
items: 「打开图片 / 视频」与「打开文件夹」合并为一个入口：打开对话框中选中文件打开文件、选中文件夹打开文件夹，也可输入文件夹路径或点「打开此文件夹」。
「更多」菜单新增「打开所在文件夹」，可在资源管理器中定位当前图片；图片右键菜单的同名入口保留。

zh-CN.title: Windows x64 更新
items: 裁剪改为可调整的会话，支持比例预设、应用和取消，并可撤销重做。
优化裁剪时的画布空间，并统一更新提示对话框。

en-US.title: Windows x64 changes
items: Crop with an adjustable selection, aspect ratio presets, apply and cancel, and undo or redo.
Improve canvas spacing during cropping and unify update dialogs.

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 裁剪改为可调整的会话，支持比例预设、应用和取消，并可撤销重做。
优化裁剪时的画布空间，并统一更新提示对话框。

en-US.title: Changes
items: Crop with an adjustable selection, aspect ratio presets, apply and cancel, and undo or redo.
Improve canvas spacing during cropping and unify update dialogs.

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 修复部分视频拖到尾部后无法正确结束或重播的问题。
统一图片与视频的切换过渡，改善视频待播与播放交互。
根据解码能力开放 HEIC 格式入口。
明确更新重启入口，并提供官网下载提示。
恢复公开发布以来的完整更新记录。

en-US.title: Changes
items: Fix ending and replaying videos whose final frames exceed the declared duration.
Unify image and video transitions and improve video loading and playback interactions.
Enable HEIC entry points according to decoding capabilities.
Clarify restart-to-update controls and provide a website download hint.
Restore the complete public release history.

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 旧版 system 识别配置统一使用默认 ONNX，避免调用不同识别后端。
改善编辑器笔触与连续绘制交互，默认线条更细。
查看器仅接收文件关联列表中的媒体格式，避免误打开不支持的文件。
Mac 与 Windows 可独立发布，更新检查按本平台版本和安装包身份判断。
保留完成编辑时覆盖原图或另存为，以及保存后的文字识别与划词。

en-US.title: Changes
items: Use the default ONNX backend for legacy system OCR preferences.
Improve editor strokes and continuous drawing with thinner default lines.
Only open media formats listed in file associations.
Allow independent Mac and Windows releases and check updates using the current platform package identity.
Retain overwrite or Save as on edit completion and text recognition after saving.

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 完成编辑时即可选择覆盖原图或另存为，不再等到切图时才提示保存。
取消另存或保存失败时保留编辑，放弃修改可返回已保存的图片。
保存后自动重新识别文字，修复旧识别结果回填和编辑后无法划词的问题。
保存确认采用紧凑圆角样式，适配深浅主题与中英文。
默认标注线条更细，减少对图片内容的遮挡。

en-US.title: Changes
items: Choose Overwrite or Save as when finishing an edit, before returning to the viewer.
Keep edits when saving is cancelled or fails; discard returns to the last saved image.
Recognize text again after saving and prevent stale OCR results from disabling text selection.
Use a compact rounded save dialog in light and dark themes, in English and Chinese.
Use thinner default annotation strokes.

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 更新检查和安装包下载默认使用 Cloudflare 官网线路，可在设置中切换至 GitHub 备用线路。
皮肤支持跟随系统，修复浅色与深色切换后的样式残留。
视频倍速改为图标按钮，播放控制条在空闲或鼠标移出时自动隐藏。
启动统计统一直连 PostHog，记录当前客户端版本、系统和架构，可在设置中关闭。
保留 macOS 13.4+ Apple Silicon 与 Intel 双架构安装包，沿用发布者签名更新。

en-US.title: Changes
items: Check for updates and download packages through the Cloudflare website route by default, with GitHub available in Settings.
Follow the system appearance and fix stale styling when switching between light and dark themes.
Use an icon for playback speed and hide video controls when idle or when the pointer leaves.
Send optional startup statistics directly to PostHog with the current app version, OS and architecture.
Retain macOS 13.4+ Apple Silicon and Intel packages with publisher-signed updates.

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: - 下载更新期间隐藏取消按钮、禁止切换线路，退出时提示并保留已下载内容。
- 下载完成后可重启以静默安装新版；安装前重新校验安装包，安装失败不会反复自动安装。
- 修复 Windows 更新记录显示，官网按访问设备默认选择 Windows 或 Mac 下载。
- 本次发布为 Windows x64；macOS 保持 0.1.12。
安装包通过 Cloudflare CDN 分发，GitHub 提供备用下载。

en-US.title: Changes
items: WePic Windows 0.1.14

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: Windows 0.1.13：启动统计改为直连 PostHog，下载和更新使用 Cloudflare CDN。
macOS 安装包和自动更新身份仍为 0.1.12。本次仅发布 Windows x64 0.1.13。

en-US.title: Changes
items: Windows 0.1.13: startup statistics connect directly to PostHog; downloads and updates use Cloudflare CDN.

zh-CN.title: 初始版本
items: WePic 初始版本发布。
支持图片浏览与基础编辑、视频及实况照片播放。
支持本地文字提取，可配置 AI 服务进行识别、润色与翻译。

en-US.title: Initial release
items: Initial release of WePic.
Browse and edit images, and play videos and Live Photos.
Extract text locally, with optional AI services for recognition, rewriting and translation.
